subject: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review

Team —

Quick ask: StartupPilot is pushing to close this week. They’re a Series B analytics startup and are requesting a one-time 25% concession on the first 12 months of their AWS marketplace listing price so they can match a direct discount their finance team received from a competitor. The economics are small (net new ARR ~ $240k annualized, 12-month committed). Important context:

- They’ll list via AWS co-sell and have a committed go-to-market activity with the Cloud Partner team.
- Customer is sensitive to PO timing — procurement requested a DocuSign SOW + AWS PO form to process invoice by 6/21.
- We’ve got a product-led pilot already running that’s healthy; this is the expansion into a paid marketplace listing to accelerate adoption.

Attachments: startuppilot_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW), aws_po_form.docx (procurement form)

Specific ask: can Deal Desk approve a one-time 25% concession against the published AWS private offer for the first 12 months? If not, what range can we offer now so we don’t lose momentum?

I’m looping Rachel for pricing input and Laura for final approval if we need an exec sign-off. Customer contact below.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review

Jordan —

Thanks for the context. A few clarifying Qs before I take to pricing council:

1) Is the 25% concession off list or off our standard private-offer price?
2) Is the 12-month commit legally required (SOW) or do they want a billing credit applied to their first year only?
3) Do we have co-sell eligibility confirmed by AWS (partner team)? If AWS will subsidize any portion, that changes the approval path.

From a Deal Desk perspective, one-time concessions that reduce effective first-year ARR below 60% of list require VP sign-off. If this is purely a go-to-market incentive and AWS is co-funding, we can probably approve up to 15% at my level. Anything above that needs Laura.

Jordan, can you confirm the answers inline and attach any AWS confirmation from the partner team?

—Markus
Markus Klein
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@startuppilot.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@startuppilot.com>, AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side:

- The 12-month commitment is standard for our procurement team; they’ll process a single-year PO.
- We were offered a 25% introductory concession by one of Redwood’s competitors for the first year — that’s what triggered this ask.
- AWS partner team (cc’d) has verbally indicated they’ll prioritize co-sell but have not committed to subsidizing any price. We can push them for a formal note, but need Redwood’s pricing confirmation first.

We can sign the SOW and return the PO by 6/21 if the concession is agreed. If not, we’ll need to pause while we re-evaluate with procurement — that may push the start into July.

Appreciate the help —
Olivia Grant
Head of Partnerships, StartupPilot
olivia@startuppilot.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 10:22 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
>
> Thanks for the context. A few clarifying Qs before I take to pricing council:
>
> 1) Is the 25% concession off list or off our standard private-offer price?
> 2) Is the 12-month commit legally required (SOW) or do they want a billing credit applied to their first year only?
> 3) Do we have co-sell eligibility confirmed by AWS (partner team)? If AWS will subsidize any portion, that changes the approval path.
>
> From a Deal Desk perspective, one-time concessions that reduce effective first-year ARR below 60% of list require VP sign-off. If this is purely a go-to-market incentive and AWS is co-funding, we can probably approve up to 15% at my level. Anything above that needs Laura.

Jordan / Markus —

I’m OK to approve a one-time 20% concession for the first 12 months provided all of the following are met:

- StartupPilot executes a 12-month PO and returns the signed SOW by 6/21 (attachment confirmed).
- Sales records the co-sell activation plan in the shared Drive (link requested) and provides an AWS partner contact who will commit to joint GTM activities.
- We include a clause in the SOW that the concession is a one-time, non-recurring incentive and that subsequent renewals will be at published pricing (we’ll ensure legal language).

If Markus is comfortable with 20% (vps sign-off not required), I will send the approval email and copy Legal for SOW language. Markus — please confirm you’re good with 20% and I’ll loop legal.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@startuppilot.com>, Procurement <procurement@startuppilot.com>, AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time AWS listing concession for StartupPilot - quick review

Olivia —

Thanks for the quick reply. Good news: internal approval granted for a one-time 20% concession on year one. Conditions (we’ll follow up with Legal):

- Sign and return the attached SOW and PO by 6/21.
- Concession is non-recurring and tied to the first 12 months only.
- AWS partner confirmation of co-sell activities requested; we’ll work with your AWS contact to get a formal note.

Markus / Rachel / Laura — I’ve attached the SOW and PO form (startuppilot_SOW_v2.pdf, aws_po_form.docx) in this message for reference and will open the DocuSign after Olivia confirms. Olivia, can you confirm you’ll sign and submit the PO this week so we can get the marketplace listing live?

Thanks everyone — excited to get this across the line.

Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
